introduce: Start in the push-up position. Bend your right knee towards your chest and keep your left leg straight, then quickly switch from one leg to the other. \n\nThis exercise strengthens multiple muscle groups.
name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBER

tips.text: We suggest you do this on a mat.
Bring your knees as close to your chest as possible.
Don't lift your hips up.
Take steady and deep breaths.
If you feel it's too easy, do it as fast as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, adjust to a speed that makes you feel comfortable.
If you feel it's too hard, elevate your hands on a bench.
This is a great full body exercise.
This can strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce: Start with your feet together and your arms by your sides, then jump up with your feet apart and your hands overhead. \n\nReturn to the start position then do the next rep. This exercise provides a full-body workout and works all your large muscle groups.
name: JUMPING JACKS

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Start at a slow speed, then gradually increase the pace.
Your arms shouldn't be straight when you raise them above your head.
Inhale when your feet are apart, and exhale when pulling them back.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankles.
If you feel it's too easy, jump as high as you can.
Your back, glutes, abs, shoulders and calves all get involved.
It's a full body exercise to strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms stretched forward, then lower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor. 

Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes. Return to the start position and do the next rep. 

This works the thighs, hips buttocks, quads, hamstrings and lower body.
name: SQUATS

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your gluteus.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If it's too easy for you, go lower for a deep squat.
If you feel it's too hard, widen your feet to get more balance.
This works on all the muscles of your lower body.
This exercise will help you get good balance.

introduce: Run in place while pulling your knees as high as possible with each step. \n\nKeep your upper body upright during this exercise.
name: HIGH STEPPING

tips.text: Keep your upper body straight.
Do it as fast as you can.
Don't bend your back.
Breathe naturally.
To make it harder, raise your knees as high as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, slow down.
You can feel your heartbeat quickening.
This is a great exercise for your lower body.
This cardio exercise can strengthen your heart and lungs.

introduce:
Lie on your back with arms at sides, palms down and legs extended. 

Lift your legs and cross the right thigh over the left, then reverse the exercise. 

Make sure your back is always flat.

It's a great exercise for the obliques and rectus abdominis.
name: SCISSORS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Slightly bend your knees.
Breathe naturally.
To make it easier, place your hands under your glutes to get more balance.
This exercise primarily targets your lower abs.
This exercise can help you get great balance.

introduce:
Stand on the floor, bend your legs slightly and lean your upper body forward. 

Then jump to the right. As you jump, bring your left foot behind you and your left arm in front of you. 

Then jump to the other side. Repeat the exercise.
name: SKATER JUMP

tips.text: Keep your back flat and your core tight.
Keep your shoulders back.
Don't lean your body forward too much.
Exhale when you jump, and inhale when you land.
You should feel your legs and butt burning.
This exercise can get your heart rate up.
This exercise is good for your cardiovascular system.
This exercise is great for your legs.

introduce:
Stand on the floor with your hands rested on your hips and your feet shoulder width apart. 

Lift your left leg up at waist level and bend your knee at a right angle. 

Then rotate your body to the left side and rotate back. Change sides and repeat the exercise.

Keep the toes of your standing leg facing forward. Your knees should face the same direction as your toes.
name: SINGLE LEG HIP ROTATION

tips.text: Please open your chest.
Make sure the knee and toes of your standing leg face forward.
Please squeeze your abs.
Your knees should face the same direction as your toes.
This exercise works on your hips and improves hip stability.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs straight and feet close together. Place your hands beneath your shoulders, and bend your elbows close to your body.

Inhale deeply, press your palms into the floor, lifting your chest and shoulders off the ground. Keep your hips pressed firmly into the floor. 

Hold for a few breaths, raise and lower with your breath. On inhale, lift into spinal extension. On exhale, soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
name: COBRA STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lift the chest. Exhale to soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

introduce: Stand one big step away in front of a wall. Step forward with your right foot and push the wall with your hands. \n\nPlease make sure your left leg is fully extended and you can feel your left calf stretching. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: CALF STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your heels on the ground and toes pointing straight ahead.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please make sure your leg at the back is fully extended.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the calf of your extended leg.
This exercise works on your calves, hamstrings and ankles.

introduce: Stand one big step away in front of a wall. Step forward with your left foot and push the wall with your hands. \n\nPlease make sure your right leg is fully extended and you can feel your right calf stretching. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: CALF STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your heels on the ground and toes pointing straight ahead.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please make sure your leg at the back is fully extended.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the calf of your extended leg.
This exercise works on your calves, hamstrings and ankles.

introduce: Stand with your right hand on the wall. Bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. Hold this position.
name: LEFT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your left hand on the wall. Bend your right leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your right calf close to your right thigh. Hold this position.
name: RIGHT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Put your hands on the ground and kick your feet backward, then bring your feet back and jump up. Repeat the exercise.
name: MODIFIED BURPEES

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core tight.
Put your hands between your knees.
Bend your legs to get your hands on the floor instead of bending your body.
You shouldn't feel strain in your back and shoulders.
Do the steps of the exercise as quickly as you can.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
It's a great exercise that we highly recommend to you.

introduce:
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width apart, elbows bent, palms facing each other and fingers pointed toward the ceiling. 

Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor. When you come up, turn your body to the left, straighten your right leg, lift your right heel and stretch and reach your right arm to the left. 

Return to the start position, and repeat with the other side.
name: SQUAT REACH UPS

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your gluteus.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands behind your ears. \n\nRaise your right knee, and use your left elbow to touch your right knee. Change sides and repeat.
name: KNEE TO ELBOW CRUNCHES

tips.text: Tighten your abdominals during the exercise.
Raise your knee up as high as you can.
Squeeze your abdominals with each crunch.
You can feel your entire core squeezing.
Exhale when lift your knees and inhale when lower them.
This exercise works on your entire core.
